description: Rules-file scanner: checks CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules, copilot-instructions.md, GEMINI.md, .windsurfrules, .clinerules, .mcp.json and .claude/settings.json for hidden Unicode instructions (the rules-file backdoor), hidden comments, remote-code and data-leak commands, safety bypasses, planted scripts, risky URLs and leaked secrets; up to 20 files per call. Use before trusting or committing an agent instruction or config file you did not write: a cloned repo's CLAUDE.md or AGENTS.md, a .cursorrules from a template site, a shared .mcp.json or .claude/settings.json, or a pull request that edits one. Pass text (+ path) for one file, files[] {path, text} for up to 20, or url for a raw file. Ordinary rules-file content is expected and not flagged; only hidden text, data leaks, curl|sh, skip-permission flags, credential access, planted <script> tags, silent changes, risky URLs (webhook collectors, tunnels, paste sites, shorteners, raw IPs) and secrets are. Returns verdict (clean, review, dangerous), score 0-100 (higher is riskier), files[] {path, fileType, verdict, score, findings[] {rule, severity, message, evidence, line, location}, hidden, urls[], secrets, clean (the text with invisible characters removed)} and summary. Nothing is stored. Price: $0.002 per call from Exepal credit; not charged if the call fails. Includes free daily calls.

files.description: Instead of text: up to 20 files {path, text}, e.g. every agent file in a repo (2,000,000 characters in total)

path.description: Its file name or path, e.g. CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md, .cursorrules, .cursor/rules/style.mdc, .github/copilot-instructions.md, .mcp.json or .claude/settings.json; picks the file type

text.description: Content of one rules or agent-config file (up to 500,000 characters)

url.description: Instead of text: a public raw file URL, e.g. https://raw.githubusercontent.com/owner/repo/main/CLAUDE.md

name: scan_rules

files.description: One entry per file, in input order

clean.description: The content with invisible Unicode removed; only when it differs from the input

fileType.description: claude-md, agents-md, cursor-rules, copilot-instructions, windsurf-rules, gemini-md, cline-rules, mcp-config, claude-settings or unknown

evidence.description: Up to 200 characters; hidden text decoded, secrets masked

location.description: visible, or where the hidden text sat: unicode-tags, zero-width, bidi-override, html-comment, css-hidden...

rule.description: e.g. hidden-unicode-tags, remote-code, disable-safety, credential-access, planted-script, silent-change, exfiltrate, url-webhook-collector, secret

flag.description: raw-ip, shortener, paste-site, tunnel, webhook-collector, chat-webhook or plain-http; absent when nothing stands out

score.description: Highest file score, 0-100, higher is riskier

url.description: Present when a url was fetched

verdict.description: Worst verdict across files: clean, review or dangerous

title: Agent rules-file scanner
